title: Concession in Opinion: Bár... mégis, jóllehet, noha

sections.title: Forming Concessive Clauses
sections.content: You know *annak ellenére, hogy* from B1 Unit 9, *bár* from B1 Unit 20 and *habár* from B1 Unit 26. *Noha* and *jóllehet* work the same way, and you have met them in earlier units. Admitting a fair point makes your own view stronger: *bár... mégis* (although... still), *jóllehet* (even though), *noha* (albeit). The first clause admits the point and the main clause, often with *mégis*, gives your view.

items.spanish: Bár vannak hibái a rendszernek, mégis ez a legmegbízhatóbb megoldás.
items.english: Although the system has flaws, it is still the most reliable solution.

items.spanish: Jóllehet nem mindenki ért egyet, a többség támogatja a döntést.
items.english: Even though not everyone agrees, the majority supports the decision.

items.spanish: Noha a vita heves volt, a felek békésen váltak el.
items.english: Albeit the debate was heated, the parties parted peacefully.
